overview_description.description: OjrahApp is an all-in-one platform for taxi management, fully integrated with TGA regulations for complete compliance management. It streamlines operations by managing vehicle provision, hardware installation, insurance, and maintenance. Combining fleet management, dispatching, and ERP features into a user-friendly interface, OjrahApp enhances operational efficiency and reduces costs for taxi companies.

product.name: Technical Equipment Services
product.description: Provision and installation of digital taximeters, tracking devices, internet, cameras, rear entertainment screens, smart front screens, emergency buttons, seat sensors, and receipt printers.

product.name: External Equipment Services
product.description: Provision of external equipment for taxis, including printing the approved taxi logo, license number, and advertisements.

product.name: Vehicle Tracking and Monitoring
product.description: Tracking vehicle locations and monitoring their movements on the map, including vehicle condition and driver performance.

product.name: Integrated Management System
product.description: A system for issuing reports on vehicle movement history and defining geofences.

product.name: Financing Options
product.description: Offering convenient financing options and flexible installments for purchasing and using services.

product.name: Quick Device Installation
product.description: Providing quick installation of devices and immediate account activation on the platform.
